name: zero-to-one-ml-foundations
description: Executable proofs, KV-cache math, quantization, and drift pipelines for the Zero-to-One ML Foundations track

scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && uv run mypy examples/py
scripts.lint: oxlint -c ../../.oxlintrc.json examples/ts && uv run ruff check examples/py
scripts.fmt: oxfmt -c ../../.oxfmtrc.json . && uv run ruff format examples/py
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt -c ../../.oxfmtrc.json --check . && uv run ruff format --check examples/py
